High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 4707 of 2024
Applicant :- Kartikey Kumar Sony

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Rahul Yadav,Rajesh Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikram D. Chauhan,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned AGA and perused the material available on record.

2. The present Anticipatory Bail Application has been filed with the prayer to grant transit bail/limited anticipatory bail to the applicant - Kartikey Kumar Sony in Case Crime No. 181 of 2023 under Sections 498A, 406, 323, 504, 506 and 34 I.P.C., Police Station - Kasarwadwali, District - Thande (Maharastra).
3.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is brother-in-law and case arises out of matrimonial dispute and a FIR has been lodged in Police Station Kasarwadwali Thande (Maharastra).
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is apprehending arrest.
In order to seek his legal remedies before the court concerned in State of Maharastra, it is submitted that the applicant is seeking transit bail/limited anticipatory bail for a period of one month.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that on account of distance the applicant is not in a position to appear and sought legal remedies before the court having jurisdiction.

It is further submitted by Kartikey Kumar Sony vs State Of U.P. on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95342863/

sentences.text: learned counsel for applicant that applicant is innocent and has no concern with the present matter.
Allegations levelled against the applicant are false.
It is further argued that no prima facie case is made out against the applicant.
If the applicant is enlarged on anticipatory bail, he will not misuse the liberty and cooperate with the investigation.
The applicant has apprehension of his arrest by the police any time.
4. Learned A.G.A. submits that no case has been registered against applicant in State of Uttar Pradesh and no warrant has been received from State of Maharastra in respect of arrest of the applicant.
5. It is settled principle of law that the object of bail is to secure the attendance of the accused.

No material particulars or circumstances suggestive of the applicant fleeing from justice or thwarting the course of justice or creating other troubles in the shape of repeating offences or intimidating witnesses and the like have been shown by learned AGA for the State.

6. It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant will participate in the course of justice and investigation and would appear before the court concerned within the time granted by this Court and apply for bail/anticipatory bail, in accordance with law.

7. Considering the statement made by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant will participate in the on going investigation and will seek legal remedies as available under law in State of Maharastra where FIR has been lodged, the applicant is granted transit bail/limited anticipatory bail for a period of one month from today on his furnishing a personal bond of Rs.25,000/- with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Prayagraj or any other Magistrate authorized by him, in respect of offence described in para-2 of the present order with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant is directed to participate in the on going investigation and would be at liberty to seek all his legal remedies as may be available under law.

(ii) In the event, applicant does not appear/seek legal remedies as available under law within a period of one month from today, the present transit bail/limited anticipatory bail application would stand automatically revoked.
9. With the directions made above, the anticipatory bail application stands allowed.

Order Date :- 14.8.2024 S.Prakash  Kartikey Kumar Sony vs State Of U.P. on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95342863/
